fact: On 9 August 2026 a deputy described a bill submitted to the House communications committee requiring disclosure of AI-generated or altered content, targeting deepfake impersonation, and creating a national committee to regulate digital content.
title: مشروع قانون بالبرلمان لمواجهة مخاطر الذكاء الاصطناعي عبر الكشف عن المحتوى المصطنع
